question: How is the covering of observance composed and what world lies above it?
premises: The covering of observance has five worlds and encloses the covering of Ananta.
Above the observance covering is the auspicious-Shiva level.
There is the great world named Sadakhya.
inference: The observance covering leads upward to the great Sadakhya world in the auspicious-Shiva realm.
uncertainties: The compound in token 3 is compressed; the ablative sense of sāmayāt is inferred from the sequence.
plain_english: The covering of observance contains five worlds and encloses the covering of Ananta. Above it is the auspicious-Shiva level, where there is the great world called Sadakhya.
